verified_findings.observed_behavior: BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID is defined as 1 in main.c, which hardcodes MY_TANK_ID to 1 at boot regardless of Flash override or DIP switch readings.
verified_findings.impact: All production slave units flashed with this image will boot with Tank ID 1, causing immediate bus collision and communication collapse on the multi-drop UART bus.
verified_findings.evidence: main.c:53 `#define BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID 1` and main.c:204 `#if (BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID > 0) MY_TANK_ID = BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID; #else ...`
verified_findings.verification_method: Verify DIP switch reading correctly sets MY_TANK_ID when BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID is 0.

verified_findings.observed_behavior: Hardware Independent Watchdog (IWDG) is not initialized or refreshed anywhere in the STM32 codebase.
verified_findings.impact: If the main loop halts due to heavy industrial ESD/EMI or memory corruption while the heater relay pin PB15 is HIGH, the heater remains continuously energized, risking fluid boil-off, dry-burning, and thermal runaway.
verified_findings.evidence: Complete absence of MX_IWDG_Init or HAL_IWDG_Refresh calls in main.c and stm32g4xx_hal_conf.h.
verified_findings.recommended_fix: Enable IWDG in STM32CubeMX with a 1000ms timeout and call HAL_IWDG_Refresh() in the main loop.
verified_findings.verification_method: Induce main loop freeze and confirm hardware reset within 1 second.

verified_findings.observed_behavior: X9C103S bit-banging wiper routines execute a software delay loop for up to 100 pulses inside a global __disable_irq() critical section, masking interrupts for up to 600 microseconds.
verified_findings.impact: Disabling global interrupts for 600us causes UART RX character loss (USART3 FIFO disabled; Overrun Error occurs after 2 bytes) and misses zero-cross EXTI edges, causing phase firing timing jitter.
verified_findings.evidence: x9c103s.c:31 `__disable_irq()` followed by a 100-iteration loop calling `X9C_DelayUs(3U)` twice per step.
verified_findings.recommended_fix: Remove global interrupt disable around the entire step loop; execute wiper pulses asynchronously via a timer state machine.
verified_findings.verification_method: Measure UART RX error counter and zero-cross interrupt jitter while triggering frequency changes.

verified_findings.observed_behavior: stm_son_veri_zamani[] array is initialized to 0. For the first 3000ms after boot, `(millis() - 0) < 3000` evaluates to true even if no STM32 telemetry has been received.
verified_findings.impact: Master considers all non-existent/disconnected slave tanks as connected for the first 3 seconds after power-on, allowing START commands to be sent to offline tanks.
verified_findings.evidence: ekran_kontrol.ino:81 `return (millis() - stm_son_veri_zamani[goz_id]) < STM_BAGLANTI_TIMEOUT;` where initial value is 0.
verified_findings.recommended_fix: Require `stm_bagli[goz_id]` to be true in `isKartBagli()` or initialize `stm_son_veri_zamani[]` to -30000.
verified_findings.verification_method: Attempt to trigger START within 1 second of power-on without connected slaves.

verified_findings.observed_behavior: AC_HALF_CYCLE_US is hardcoded to 10000us (50Hz) and TRIAC_MAX_DELAY_US to 9500us. On 60Hz mains, half-cycle duration is 8333us.
verified_findings.impact: When operated on 60Hz mains, firing delays exceeding 8333us are reset by the next zero-cross EXTI before firing, causing complete cut-off in low power modes (0-15%).
verified_findings.recommended_fix: Measure actual zero-cross period dynamically using input capture or EXTI tick differences.
verified_findings.verification_method: Simulate 60Hz zero-cross signals and observe triac gate pulse generation.

verified_findings.observed_behavior: T0:SET_ID broadcast command is accepted and processed during active SYS_MODE_RUNNING state, executing blocking Flash page erase (20-40ms).
verified_findings.impact: Receiving a broadcast ID change while running stalls CPU execution, missing zero-cross interrupts and corrupting active process state.
verified_findings.evidence: esp32_uart.c:98 `if (tank_id != 0 && (uint8_t)tank_id != MY_TANK_ID) return;` accepts tank_id == 0 for all commands.
verified_findings.recommended_fix: Restrict `T0:` broadcast handling exclusively to IDLE mode and limit to harmless inspection/assignment commands.
verified_findings.verification_method: Send `T0:SET_ID:2` during active process and observe state rejection.

verified_findings.observed_behavior: Single rx_line buffer drops all incoming UART bytes while line_ready is 1, and resets rx_index to 0 on buffer overflow without resync state.
verified_findings.impact: Rapid burst commands sent from ESP32 master are silently dropped on STM32 slave side.
verified_findings.evidence: esp32_uart.c:271 `/* if line_ready is still set... incoming bytes are dropped */`.
verified_findings.recommended_fix: Implement a circular buffer (ring FIFO) for UART RX lines.
verified_findings.verification_method: Send 5 rapid consecutive commands over UART and verify all 5 are parsed.

verified_findings.observed_behavior: HMI save handlers execute blocking delay(400) and delay(600) calls for UI button color animation.
verified_findings.impact: Blocks main loop for up to 600ms, stalling UART telemetry reception and causing multi-drop RX buffer overflows.
verified_findings.recommended_fix: Replace delay() with a non-blocking millis() timer state machine.
verified_findings.verification_method: Confirm main loop latency remains below 1ms during save operations.
